alerts.title: Security Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Anomalies detected by the daily analysis — no action runs without your confirmation

descriptions.1: View access only. Cannot create, edit or delete any record.
descriptions.2: Can view and create records. Cannot edit or delete.
descriptions.3: Can view, create and edit records. Cannot delete or export.
descriptions.4: Full record management including export. Cannot manage users.
descriptions.5: Default level. Full record management plus limited user visibility.
descriptions.6: Can manage users within their department.
descriptions.7: Can manage users and configure security groups and departments.
descriptions.8: Full access to all modules plus global settings management.
descriptions.9: System administrator. All permissions except superadmin-exclusive actions.
descriptions.10: Unrestricted access. Exclusive to superadmin role. Can assign any level.

bulkResetPassword.title: Reset passwords
bulkResetPassword.subtitle: Resets the password of all active users: they will be left without a password and receive an email with a link to choose a new one. First it calculates who would be affected, without changing anything.
bulkResetPassword.includeSuperadminsWarning: They are skipped by default. Including them leaves every superadmin without a password until they use the link they receive.

visibility.title: Navigation permissions
visibility.subtitle: Exceptions for this person, on top of their role's visibility. A module or item left unchecked here inherits whatever the role already has.

bulkVisibility.title: Module visibility by UAT stage
bulkVisibility.subtitle: Hides or restores modules and access for ALL non-superadmin users at once — useful for rolling out modules stage by stage. Superadmin is never affected. Doesn't change any real permission, only what shows in the menu. Takes effect the next time each user logs in or refreshes their session.
bulkVisibility.helper: The checkbox marks what will be included in the next action (Hide/Restore) — it is not the current state. Each row's real state shows in the Hidden/Visible label.
bulkVisibility.noChanges: No changes — the selection was already in that state.
bulkVisibility.selectAtLeastOne: Pick at least one module or access before applying.
